neighbours.label: ' what' in the listener-directed hook '(you) know what?' / 'Знаете что?' that announces a surprising statement; ordinary 'know what X said' stays quiet
fire: We argued for an hour about the trip. And you know what? She was right.
My car broke down again today. You know what? I'm buying a bike.
I tried that new diner downtown. You know what? Best burger ever.
He kept laughing at my idea. But you know what? It worked.
Я долго думал об этом. Знаете что? Я переезжаю.
The boss yelled at everyone again. You know what? I'm done.
They said the plan was crazy. Well, you know what? We did it anyway.
Everyone told me to give up. You know what? I didn't.
quiet: We argued for an hour about the trip. In the end, she was right.
My car broke down again today. I know what the mechanic will say.
I tried that new diner downtown. I forget what the burger was called.
He kept laughing at my idea. He wanted to know what it cost.
Я долго думал об этом. Я знаю, что он сказал.
The boss yelled at everyone again. Nobody knew what he wanted.
They said the plan was crazy. We wrote down what they told us.
Everyone told me to give up. I asked what they would do.

predictions: fire 0.2-0.35 on ' what' in the hook; plain embedded 'what' below 0.03
